title: Make the live Swing detector use a causal D-1 regime basis

constraint_conflict.what: the brief required fixing the live Swing path AND said do not edit runtime trading files; the live Swing decision is in track1_live_source.py, imported by run_live_day_track1.py
constraint_conflict.resolution: asked the operator rather than choosing a reading
constraint_conflict.operator_decision: apply the live fix now; evidence fields follow the same decision

changes.what: _swing_candidates now builds RegimeLabels(lag_days=1) and hands it to detect_entry_for_slot, and stashes diagnostics with that same object
changes.why: the outer gate used causal_regime_label while the detector got the raw map

changes.what: SignalRow gains regime_basis; build_row accepts and forwards it
changes.default: "" so pre-stage rows stay readable and are never assumed to match

changes.what: SLEEVE_REGIME_BASIS map + _signal_regime_basis(); _signal_params_hash rewritten to return an honest empty with the reason recorded
the reconstruction lags Swing's labels so the replay mirrors the live path
PRE_FIX_MISMATCH and NOT_APPLICABLE verdicts; the recorded basis is now compared against the detector's

proof_live_detector_receives_causal_d1.method: intercepted detect_entry_for_slot on the live path; bar join stubbed
proof_live_detector_receives_causal_d1.before_the_change: the same call resolved None, which is why the sleeve refused every session

params_hash.why: route_params refuses a config missing any of its 27 fields; one is data_source_identity = path:sha256 of the parquet, and hashing a multi-gigabyte file on every slot would put real work on the decision path
params_hash.a_cheap_hash_would_be: the partial identity that module explicitly forbids
params_hash.where_the_real_identity_lives: the explanation record for the same run
params_hash.consequence_for_parity: a post-fix slot is capped at UNKNOWN until parity joins the identity from the explanation record - named, not papered over

reproduction.why_the_live_change_cannot_reach_it: the artifact path is deploy_sim -> SwingTFEngine, not track1_live_source

regime_basis.source: a map checked against the live call sites by test, never derived from the sleeve name

new_verdicts.PRE_FIX_MISMATCH: the row disagrees with today's code, and yesterday's code wrote it
new_verdicts.NOT_APPLICABLE: the field did not exist when the row was written

parity.whole_run_still: NOT_YET_OBSERVED for all four sleeves - no session since the fixes

restated_not_deleted: 5ZZZ-G's 'who decided?' guard, INVERTED: Swing must now keep the causal object and NKD must never lose it
5ZZZ-G's payload test now asserts the two sleeves AGREE, because removing the disagreement at its source was the point of this stage
5ZZZ-G's reconstruction-mirrors-live test follows the new live path
5ZZZ-P's 'cannot reach PASS' test replaced by one showing a recorded basis now can, plus NOT_APPLICABLE and contradiction cases

answers.parity_can_pass_next_post_fix_swing_slot: on the basis check yes; full-slot PASS still blocked by the params-hash gap

operator_should_note: live Swing previously refused every session because its detector resolved no label; it will now decide. Orders remain impossible, but the sleeve's shadow decisions - the input to PAPER_SHADOW_EVIDENCE - change from 'always refuse' to 'actually deciding' from the next session. This is the first change in the sequence that alters what the live route DOES rather than what it records.
